title: Strict pullback augmentation computes the scalar transpose
statement: Fix l,E, arbitrary schemes X,Y and f:X→Y, a system operation model and representative-normalized RealizationModel [def-sf-integral-system-canonical-bridge], a normalized Pull presentation p [def-sf-pull-completion-comparison], and a good flat-term K-flat complex P on Y [lem-pur-integral-operations-well-defined]. The reconstruction unit at ordinary derived pullback QP, followed by total limit of realization.reductionPull and the full reference pullback Roos model [def-pur-completed-pullback-tensor-comparison], equals the ordinary pullback localization factor followed by Q of the actual quotient roosUnit on the pulled complex followed by Q of the Roos map induced by p.tower. This is a whole Roos equation before descent to arbitrary objects; it does not assert invertibility.

source.place: Maps-used sentence, primitive tensor/pullback coefficient comparison and open-factor normalization.

proof.text: Expand pullbackTensorReferencePullbackModel and use RealizationModel.model on the ordinary pulled good complex. Naturality of the reconstruction unit moves the ordinary-pullback localization factor in front.

Extend the normalized ordinary-limit/Roos inclusion from K-injective tower complexes to every complex by naturality and a K-injective resolution. The ordinary Roos inclusion is natural, as seen from its product coordinates and its zero shifted coordinate. Cancel the exact restriction factors. The defining adjunction-transpose equation of pullbackTensorReductionModel and naturality of pullbackTensorLimitUnit now give the whole derived transpose formula.

Apply the ordinary finite projection identity for every n. Product extensionality identifies the first coordinates after the two strict tower maps; both shifted coordinates vanish. The explicit mapping-cocone lift and diagonal product-map formulas prove the whole cochain equation. Apply Q and compose with the ordinary pullback factor.

proof_origin.place: K7: original three-step route made explicit using the published reduction-model Hom normalization, K-injective extension of the Roos inclusion, and a finite ordinary projection identity.

theorem pullQuotientTranspose_onGood
    (system : IntegralSystemRealization.Operations l E)
    (realization : IntegralSystemRealization.RealizationModel l E system)
    {X Y : Scheme.{u}} (f : X ⟶ Y) (p : OpenFactorCoherence.Pull l E f)
    (P : (integralOperationsGoodComplex l E Y).FullSubcategory) :
    (IntegralSystemRealization.calculus l E X).adjunction.unit.app
        ((IntegralSystemRealization.ringedPull l E f).obj (DerivedCategory.Q.obj P.obj)) ≫
      (coefficientSequenceLimit l E X).map
        ((realization.reductionPull f).hom.app (DerivedCategory.Q.obj P.obj)) ≫
      (pullbackTensorReferencePullbackModel l E f P).hom =
      (IntegralSystemRealization.integralOrdinaryPull l E f).mapDerivedCategoryFactors.hom.app
          P.obj ≫
        DerivedCategory.Q.map (IntegralOnSlice.roosUnit l E X none
          ((OpenFactorCoherence.pullCx l E f).obj P.obj)) ≫
        DerivedCategory.Q.map (integralOperationsRoosMap (p.tower.hom.app P.obj))
